title: Incremental Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Human-in-the-Loop Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2610.12666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce iRAG, a human-in-the-loop decision-support system combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Hybrid Decision-Making. Unlike conventional RAG systems, relying on static Knowledge Bases (KBs), our proposal addresses settings where the KB is initially empty and is progressively populated through human decisions. The system stores previous decisions as retrievable precedents and moves from silent observation to evidence-grounded contestation and, finally, to autonomous handling with abstention. Against an independent baseline, iRAG matches final-decision error under 10% drift without retrieval decay and reduces it under 40% drift across all configurations. Retrieval decay improves performance on changed knowledge while increasing error on stable knowledge, evidencing a stability--plasticity trade-off rather than a general advantage. translated_title: 面向人在回路决策支持的增量式检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了iRAG，这是一个将检索增强生成（RAG）与混合决策相结合的人在回路决策支持系统。与依赖静态知识库（KB）的传统RAG系统不同，我们的方案针对的是知识库初始为空、并通过人类决策逐步填充的场景。该系统将先前的决策存储为可检索的先例，并从静默观察逐步过渡到基于证据的质疑，最终实现带有弃权机制的自主处理。相对于独立基线，iRAG在10%漂移下无需检索衰减即可达到与基线相同的最终决策错误率，并在所有配置下于40%漂移时降低了错误率。检索衰减在提升对已变化知识的处理性能的同时，增加了对稳定知识的错误率，这表明其体现的是一种稳定性与可塑性之间的权衡，而非普遍性优势。人类监督是该工作流程的架构性安排；其在真实场景中的可用性（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出了iRAG，一个知识库从空开始、通过将人类决策存储为可检索先例而逐步增量构建的人在回路决策支持系统，它从静默观察过渡到基于证据的质疑、再到带弃权的自主处理，并揭示了检索衰减带来的稳定性与可塑性权衡。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces iRAG, an incremental retrieval-augmented generation system for human-in-the-loop decision support that starts with an empty knowledge base progressively populated through human decisions stored as retrievable precedents, evolving from silent observation to evidence-grounded contestation and finally to autonomous handling with abstention, revealing a stability–plasticity trade-off induced by retrieval decay.
